name: notambourine
description: Claude Code plugins for the NoTambourine consulting practice.

plugins.name: nt-brand
plugins.description: NoTambourine brand source of truth. /nt-brand:system ships the tokens, components, fonts, and voice, plus the audit that checks copy against them.

plugins.name: nt-dev
plugins.description: Everyday development workflow: /nt-dev:pr writes a PR body against the org template, /nt-dev:cleanup audits a repo for drift, /nt-dev:recall reads a prior session back into context, and the Attentive output style trades asking for acting, then reports what changed.

plugins.name: nt-vendor
plugins.description: Third-party skills mirrored whole from their upstream repos, kept here so our own skills can call them by name. The nt-vendor prefix marks every skill in it as someone else's work.

plugins.name: wormhook
plugins.description: Blocks npm/PyPI supply-chain malware and agent-hijack persistence at the Claude Code hook — before it can run.

plugins.name: qrspi
plugins.description: GitHub-native structured feature development: Query, Research, Spec, Plan, Implement.

plugins.name: nt-share
plugins.description: Share a file, folder, or screenshot as one branded, unguessable link on share.notambourine.com. Browsers get a rendered page, curl and Slack unfurls get raw bytes from the same URL. Needs a NoTambourine-issued token.
